name: Nature Restoration Fund: Transforming Nature and Helping Nature
summary: Scottish Government competitive grants, managed by NatureScot, for habitat and species restoration, freshwater restoration, coastal and marine recovery, invasive species control and urban nature projects across Scotland.

amount.note: Helping Nature £25,000 to £250,000; Transforming Nature above £250,000

calls.label: 2026-27 delivery funding

deadline.quote: Expression of Interest deadline: Thursday 26 November 2026 at 12 noon

calls.note: Full applications are due Monday 18 January 2027 at 12 noon.

administered_by.quote: The Nature Restoration Fund includes the competitive fund, managed by NatureScot and direct funding to local authorities through the Edinburgh Process.

applicant_types.quote: Applications are invited from: Constituted organisationsRegistered charities and trusts Constituted community groups Private individuals and companies - where public benefit will be demonstrated

geography.quote: The decision making panel will seek to achieve a spread of projects across the five priority themes, and across Scotland

window.quote: Expression of Interest deadline: Thursday 26 November 2026 at 12 noon Application deadline: Monday 18 January 2027 at 12 noon

amount.quote: Amount: £25,000 to £250,000 (Helping Nature) or above £250,000 (Transforming Nature)

co_finance_required.quote: All applications will be required to confirm cash and/or in-kind contributions to the project. There is a maximum NRF intervention rate of 90% of project costs.

effort.quote: Expression of Interest deadline: Thursday 26 November 2026 at 12 noon
Application deadline: Monday 18 January 2027 at 12 noon
